scripts.title: Snowy Hub | Auto Kick, Auto Train, TP, Inf Speed & More
scripts.features:
Auto Kick Lucky Block: Automatically kicks nearby Lucky Blocks as soon as they appear.

Auto Train/Buy Weights: Automatically trains strength and purchases better weights when available.

Auto Collect Brainrots + Money: Automatically collects all nearby Brainrots and cash pickups.

Anti Tsunami (Smooth Float): Keeps your character safely above tsunami waves using smooth movement.

ESP Lucky Blocks: Highlights every Lucky Block on the map for easy locating.

TP to All Zones (Common → Mythic): Instantly teleport to any unlocked zone from Common through Mythic.

Walk Speed: Adjust your character's movement speed.

Infinite Jump: Jump endlessly without touching the ground.

Auto Redeem Codes: Automatically redeems all valid game codes for free rewards.

Anti-AFK: Prevents automatic kicks for being idle.

Premium (14): Unlocks fourteen exclusive premium-only features.

Target Zone Kick Aim: Select which zone the Auto Kick feature should prioritize.

Auto Buy MAX Weights: Automatically purchases the best available weights whenever possible.

Auto Rebirth: Automatically rebirths when the requirements are met.

Auto Sell Brainrots: Automatically sells collected Brainrots for money.

God Mode: Attempts to reduce or prevent damage using available in-game methods.

ESP Brainrots (With Rarity): Highlights all Brainrots while displaying their rarity.

TP Celestial / Divine / Infinity: Instantly teleport to the Celestial, Divine, or Infinity areas.

NoClip: Walk through walls, objects, and other obstacles.

Walk-To Lucky Block (Stealth): Automatically walks to Lucky Blocks using natural movement instead of teleporting.

Server Hop: Instantly joins a different server.
